author: mark
text: tests gate: cargo test --workspace + tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green on merged state. 645 tests pass, 2905/2905 lines covered. Two findings, both fixed in this gate's commit: (1) ETXTBSY flake on the write_script fixture sanity check — wrapped exec in the same retry budget production code uses; (2) P11 landed with non-fmt'd UI files under rustfmt 1.8 — re-fmt'd. End-to-end demo per epic done-when validated component-wise: the harness side via tests/prompt_end_to_end.rs (httpmock-driven full lernie new + lernie prompt cycle, asserts §2.6 merge=ours topology); the UI side via component tests (fs_watcher, cli_outbound, git_tree, streaming, actions); the FS contract between them is the only integration surface. Live visual demo (real Anthropic call + windowed UI) is the user's verification bar — not an agent-runnable gate.
